The '''Southern Hills''' were a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]], close to [[Abregado-rae Spaceport]]. The Southern Hills were home to a [[Gado Hill Clans|peaceful dissident movement]] that opposed the [[Tundei Tribunal|tyrannical government]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
